dimensions.assessment: Affects federal judges, the General Services Administration, and individuals involved in federal court construction projects.
dimensions.evidence: GSA must ensure courtroom sharing by magistrate, bankruptcy, and senior district judges.

dimensions.assessment: Changes operational rules for courtroom space allocation and restricts new courthouse construction design.
dimensions.evidence: GSA is prohibited from constructing a new courthouse that does not comply with the courtroom sharing requirements.

dimensions.assessment: Aims to reduce costs related to courthouses by limiting new construction and requiring full utilization of existing space.
Amends title 40 of the United States Code and requires updating the U.S. Courts Design Guide.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 40, United States Code, to limit the construction of new courthouses under certain circumstances

dimensions.assessment: Creates permanent statutory requirements for federal courthouse space and design guides.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment of this section, the Design Guide for courthouses shall be updated

missing_information: Exact dollar amounts of expected federal savings
Number of current or future courthouses impacted
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes statutory courtroom sharing policies for federal judges and limits new courthouse construction under specific conditions, affecting federal judicial administration and GSA building practices without broad societal or sweeping economic impacts.
